_meta.notes: Type-pair contribution to the default-stance score (§7.2). ALL constants here are PROJECT CALL and tunable (Jedidiah, no reserved conventions). Keys are 'typeA|typeB' where typeA/typeB are factions.faction_type values; lookup is symmetric (the evaluator tries both orders). 'requires_same_settlement' pairs only apply their value when both factions seat in the same settlement (the temple-rivalry case, §6.4). 'requires_same_religion_family' applies only when the two share an alignment/deity family (co-aligned temple rivalry). A missing pair contributes 0 (coin/strangers are neutral).

pairs.note: syndicate ↔ any lawful organization: crime vs. order (§7.2). 'any_lawful_org' is a wildcard matched when the OTHER faction is an organization-scope row with lawful alignment.

co-aligned same-settlement temples RIVALRY (§6.4): they compete for the same congregants and the same ruler's favor. Never auto-friendly. Nemesis-family temples are handled by the religion_term (-3), not here.
coin is neutral — a mercenary company defaults 0 toward anyone (§7.2).
brigands ↔ any realm: outlaws vs. the state (§7.2).

knightly order ↔ its patron realm's enemies (§7.2). 'patrons_enemies' is resolved by the evaluator from context (the order's patron realm and that realm's hostile relations); when context is absent it contributes 0.
